events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Gordon Sumner, known professionally as Sting, the iconic frontman of The Police and successful solo artist, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Sting! From The Police to his incredible solo career, his music continues to resonate. What's your favourite Sting track?

events.title: 25 years of the iPod
events.blurb: Apple first introduced the revolutionary iPod on October 23, 2001, changing the way the world listened to music.

angles.name: Tech Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember when you got your first iPod? It's 25 years since Apple unleashed the iconic device that put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and redefined how we carry our music.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Theme Tune Battle
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! We're celebrating 64 years since Dr. No premiered. What's your top 007 theme tune of all time?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder, singer, and songwriter John Lennon, who was tragically killed in 1980, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The celebrated English actor, comedian, and writer, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, John Cleese, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy icon.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago this month, The Beatles delivered their sprawling, self-titled masterpiece – better known as 'The White Album'. A double album packed with classics!

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, 35 years since we lost a true icon of rock. His incredible voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on December 3, 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Album Milestone
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. Widely considered a landmark album, it showcased their growing lyrical depth and musical sophistication.

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles' co-founder John Lennon, who was fatally shot on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: Lennon Remembrance
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon, 46 years after his passing. His legacy as a musician, artist, and peace activist continues to resonate globally.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary musician and cultural icon David Bowie, who passed away in 2016, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. A true innovator whose influence is still felt across music and culture.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, who passed away in 1977, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. His music and iconic style continue to define rock and roll.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: The iconic guitarist and founder of Led Zeppelin, Jimmy Page, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a massive happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound and one of rock's greatest guitarists.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the distinctive-voiced British rock and pop singer, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod The Mod Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! From The Faces to his incredible solo career, a true rock and roll legend.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of the iconic British band Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the legendary frontman of Madness! What's your favourite 'Nutty Boy' anthem?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The English pop and blue-eyed soul singer, Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: 80s Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the smooth voice of Paul Young! Still loving those 80s classics.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The beloved American country music superstar, singer-songwriter, and actress Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true legend of music, fashion, and philanthropy. What's your go-to Dolly track?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: The English singer, songwriter, and lead vocalist of Take That, Gary Barlow, celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! What's your favourite song he's written?
